label: Tidsbokning — Cal.com
summary: Hosted appointment scheduling through an inline Cal.com calendar. Use for service businesses, consultants and teams that need real availability, time-zone handling, reminders and booking confirmation without building a scheduling backend. Demo mode (mock: visual): without a valid Cal.com event link, the component renders a complete sample availability surface whose time buttons open an honest demo dialog — no appointment is created.
summarySv: Robust tidsbokning via Cal.com för exempelvis salonger, konsulter och kliniker. Besökaren kan välja en verklig ledig tid direkt på sajten när en Cal.com-länk är kopplad. Utan länken visas ett tydligt demoläge där bokningsflödet går att prova, men ingen tid reserveras.

envVars.purpose: Public Cal.com event path in the form username/event-type or team/team-slug/event-type. Copy the path after cal.com/ from the event type's share/embed screen. It is public configuration, not a secret; missing or placeholder values keep the component in honest visual demo mode.

notes: Keyless Next.js typecheck/build and the visual demo interaction are verified. A live booking completion against a dedicated Cal.com test event is still required before changing verificationStatus to accepted.
